mentions.name: 2zuz
mentions.description: This product search engine searches across a few large online stores and returns only products that match exactly what the user searched for, prioritizing users over advertisers. Ranking and filtering are being iterated on so results stay free of ads, sponsored suggestions, and irrelevant junk.
mentions.problem: Product searches are cluttered with ads, "inspired by your search" suggestions, and completely irrelevant results, forcing users to scroll past junk to find what they actually want.
mentions.audience: Online shoppers, especially people who buy a lot of stuff online.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on 2zuz, a product search engine that optimizes for the users rather than the advertizers.

evidence.value: I’m working on 2zuz, a product search engine that optimizes for the users rather than the advertizers.
